answer: We formulate a mechanism combining dynamic opportunity-cost bonds and subgame-perfect slashing matrices to deter Sybil attacks. Agents invest bonds in a tundra of verification, forfeiting returns upon identity multiplication. A nebula of punishment matrices enforces strict penalties for deviations. Capital barrier analysis reveals that expected payoff of Sybilization is strictly negative, rendering it irrational. In adversarial environments, strategies converge to a hollow set of equilibria, guaranteeing Sybil resistance in a strict Nash equilibrium.
